summary: Add or remove Fabric on an existing fleet member without rejoining

replay.detail: Existing endpoint claims and membership projection; history is preserved.

schema.detail: No claim shape, schema, or fleet.toml format changes.

rules.detail: Fabric add exposes before announcing; remove withdraws before unexposing and refuses the last or unusable remaining transport. Mode and transport changes serialize with worker exposure/publication; local settings failures fail the worker visibly.

compatibility.detail: Adds st fleet transports add/remove fabric and additive transports/fabric_protocol fields in fleet status JSON. Older membership builds fold the unchanged endpoint claim and refresh their route list; config-peer-only builds retain configured routes.

downtime.detail: Transport and mode changes refresh the installed services. Other peers continue using available routes during restart.

manual.detail: With --no-service or no installed service, restart the replication worker to apply changed settings; the old worker retires endpoint publication. Repair local settings read/lock errors before restarting a failed worker. Fabric trust and service grants remain operator-managed.

recovery.detail: Remove Fabric to return to a usable remaining carrier, even if the Fabric executable or daemon is unavailable. Failed exposure leaves settings and endpoint claims unchanged; unavailable unexposure reports explicit pending cleanup while withdrawal succeeds.
